evidencePolicy.selection: One latest observed case per module, width, color, and reduced-motion setting; later targeted evidence supersedes older cases. Raw reports and failed attempts are preserved.
evidencePolicy.initialMatrix: The first full 90-case matrix had source changes and a narrower source manifest. Its reconciled report repairs only shared-query-cache classifications using already-observed successful GETs; it does not alter browser observations.
evidencePolicy.sourceFreeze: Final affected UI cohorts use expanded source roots and are individually stable. Their product, fixture and graph manifests are identical; only the owned verification script changes between cohorts. The composed 90 cases are not one build-wide frozen run.
evidencePolicy.backendPython: Backend-only Python changes are outside the UI source signature.
unverified: Real Supabase authentication and database behavior
External map and road provider availability
AI generation, provider billing and external calls
Approval, deletion, account changes, writes, save persistence and mutation readback
Complete accessibility compliance and every possible user interaction
evidencePolicy.searchLimitations: Restaurants and users search input was accepted, but fixture filtering semantics were not established. Banner search also lacks a confirmed empty-state assertion. The safe read-only detail selections were observed for final users, banners, LLM and graph.
evidencePolicy.accessibleNameLimitations: Lightweight name detection is not the browser accessible-name algorithm. It flags 1 submissions, 4 reviews and 3 banner controls per case as candidates; these are not independently confirmed accessibility defects or a complete accessibility audit.
evidencePolicy.titleStyleLimitations: Exact 16px/600/24px title measurements cover the final 26 affected combinations. Older cases only assert title presence/match.
evidencePolicy.requestIsolation: Only exact loopback fixture origins were forwarded with GET/HEAD/OPTIONS. Confirmed read-only POST contracts were fulfilled inside the isolated browser; no POST was forwarded. All other methods and external origins were denied before server-bound requests.

sentry.meaning: Known absent Sentry configuration; valid fixture contract and rendered setup state, not service availability.

routes.runtimeReceiverBug: No pageerrors after parent receiver-preserving coordinate fix; last two navigation retries replaced hydration-race observations.

mobileNavigation.cause: After the last operations row is selected, intentional mobile chrome auto-hide positions the menu button above the viewport. A direct click times out. Scrolling the actual descendant scroll owner to the top reveals the header and allows the next menu click.
mobileNavigation.correction: An early progress message incorrectly attributed the timeout to graph keyboard interaction; phase capture and viewport bounds established the actual menu auto-hide cause.

sourceAtSummary.verifierChangeAfterLastRun: Only waitForFunction timeout was moved to its correct options argument; targeted ESLint and Node 24 syntax checks passed.

verification.fullTypecheck: Parent-owned final check; not repeated here.
